title: Expensive
text:
Expensive. This is a nice matching towel set, containing two bath towels, two hand towels, and four wash cloths. While I like this set and they’re good towels, I have a couple of concerns about them.

Overall this is a decent set. The color is uniform and I have found no faded spots or miscolorations. The stitching is straight and I have not seen any issues with pilling, loose loops or uneven materials. I haven’t found any real issues with the workmanship.

That said, these do shed lint in the dryer, to a point that I’d recommend some caution when throwing them in with items of dissimilar colors. The lint screen in the dryer catches a lot of lint from these towels, at least in the initial washings, and what it doesn’t catch ends up on other articles.

The second concern I have is the cost of this set. It’s not inexpensive and I am not sure the cost is justified when compared to similar sets available. Don’t get me wrong, these are very definitely better than the cheap sets you can find at national budget department stores, but I’d hesitate to say they are better enough to justify the price differential.

This is a good set of towels. They match nicely and they are well made. I question if the asking price is justified though, and I would recommend caution when tossing them in the dryer with other items.
